# NDA Data Packages {#sec-nda}

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tibble)
```

The starter kits assume that the A2CPS data were downloaded from the NIMH Data Archive (NDA). This page describes what a download contains and where the kits expect to find it.

If you do not yet have access to the NDA and plan to download data from the NDA, please follow the instructions on the A2CPS For Researchers page ([Accessing our Data](https://a2cps.org/researchers/accessing-our-data/)) and the linked tutorials.

## Data Packages

The starter kits assume that the data have been downloaded as a Data Package using [nda-tools](https://github.com/NDAR/nda-tools), and that the package was saved to `{{< var nda.dir >}}` inside the project folder. For example, a package that includes the MRI data, the genetic variant data, the demographics, and a few questionnaires looks like this (abridged):

```bash
$ tree {{< var nda.dir >}}
{{< var nda.dir >}}
├── dataset_collection.txt
├── datastructure_manifest.txt
├── experiments
│   ├── experiment_2652
│   └── experiment_2655
├── fmriresults01
│   ├── {{< var nda.prefix >}}
│   │   └── mris
│   │       ├── derivatives
│   │       └── idp
│   └── manifest-files
├── fmriresults01.txt
├── genomics_sample03
│   └── submission-85830
├── genomics_sample03.txt
├── genomics_subject02.txt
├── heal_demographics01.txt
├── image03
│   ├── {{< var nda.prefix >}}
│   │   └── mris
│   │       └── bids
│   └── manifest-files
├── image03.txt
├── md5_values.txt
├── oai_koos_womac01.txt
├── package_file_metadata_1235008.txt.gz
├── package_file_metadata_1235916.txt.gz
├── package_file_metadata_1235927.txt.gz
├── package_file_metadata_1238107.txt.gz
├── package_info.txt
├── prsupport01.txt
└── README.pdf
```

## Data Structures

A package holds one tab-separated table per NDA data structure, named after the structure (for example, `image03.txt` or `heal_demographics01.txt`). Each structure has a data dictionary on the NDA website (for example, [heal_demographics01](https://nda.nih.gov/data-structure/heal_demographics01)). The first line of every table is the column header, the second line includes a partial data dictionary, and the third line contains the first row of data.

Every table identifies participants by `subjectkey` (the NDA GUID) and `src_subject_id` (the A2CPS record ID), so these columns link one structure to another (see @sec-ids).

## Files

Some structures also reference files, such as the NIfTI images referenced by `image03`, the derivatives referenced by `fmriresults01`, or the genotypes referenced by `genomics_sample03`. Those files are downloaded into a folder named after the structure. Within that folder, the MRI files keep the path they had when A2CPS uploaded them, `{{< var nda.prefix >}}`, while the genotype files are in a folder named after the NDA submission that delivered them, `submission-85830`. Other structures, such as `prsupport01`, are only tables.

When a starter kit names a file or runs a shell command, the path starts from the folder that holds the structure's files. For example, `mris/derivatives` refers to `{{< var nda.dir >}}/fmriresults01/{{< var nda.prefix >}}/mris/derivatives`. Code chunks spell out the full path from the project folder.

## MRI

### Raw Data

Raw imaging data are stored in the [image03 Data Structure](https://nda.nih.gov/data-structure/image03) (link goes to data dictionary). Metadata are stored in `image03.txt`. This is where you will find information such as participant age, participant sex, and scan acquisition date. The imaging files are underneath `image03`.

```bash
$ ls image03/{{< var nda.prefix >}}/mris/bids/ | head
dataset_description.json
README
sessions.json
sub-10003
sub-10005
sub-10008
sub-10010
sub-10011
sub-10013
```

The contents of that folder match the contents described in @sec-raw-mri (note that the aggregated table `participants.tsv` is not included in the NDA download, as the information is available in `image03.txt`).

### Derivatives

The MRI derivatives are referenced by the [fmriresults01 Data Structure](https://nda.nih.gov/data-structure/fmriresults01), and so they are underneath `fmriresults01/{{< var nda.prefix >}}/mris/derivatives`, in one folder per pipeline. The image-derived phenotypes described in @sec-mri-idps are underneath `fmriresults01/{{< var nda.prefix >}}/mris/idp`.

### Experiments

A package with fMRI data includes an "experiments" folder, which provides some information on how the two types of fMRI scans were collected.

```{r}
#| echo: false

tribble(
  ~"Experiment"             , ~"Files"                                                                                                                                                                                           ,
  "experiment_2652 (rfMRI)" , '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/experiment_2652.xml dname="experiment_2652" label="experiment_2652.xml" >}} {{< downloadthis assets/nda/A2CPS_rest.txt dname="A2CPS_rest" label="A2CPS_rest.txt" >}}' ,
  "experiment_2655 (tfMRI)" , '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/experiment_2655.xml dname="experiment_2655" label="experiment_2655.xml" >}} {{< downloadthis assets/nda/A2CPS_cuff.txt dname="A2CPS_cuff" label="A2CPS_cuff.txt" >}}'
)
```

## Genomics

The genetic variant data, including the imputed genotypes, are referenced by the [genomics_sample03 Data Structure](https://nda.nih.gov/data-structure/genomics_sample03), and so they are underneath `genomics_sample03/submission-85830`. Subject-level information about the genotyping is in `genomics_subject02.txt`. For more on these files, see @sec-snps and @sec-genomics.

## Additional NDA Metadata

The rest of the files are metadata associated with the storage of the dataset in the NDA or information about the Data Package. Most users will not need to interact with these files unless something has gone wrong with the download.

```{r}
#| echo: false

tribble(
  ~`File/Directory`                                                                                                                                   , ~`Description/Notes`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               ,
  '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/dataset_collection.txt dname="dataset_collection" label="dataset_collection.txt" >}}'                                  , "Table with identifiers relating to how the data were uploaded"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ,
  '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/datastructure_manifest.txt dname="datastructure_manifest" label="datastructure_manifest.txt" >}}'                      , "Table with partial information about how the files are stored on the NDA AWS S3 bucket. This example file contains the first 10 rows."                                                                                                                                                            ,
  '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/md5_values.txt dname="md5_values" label="md5_values.txt" >}}'                                                          , "Table with MD5 File Checksums for each of the files in the image03 folder. This example file contains the first 10 rows."                                                                                                                                                                         ,
  '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/package_file_metadata_1235008.txt dname="package_file_metadata_1235008" label="package_file_metadata_1235008.txt" >}}' , "Additional metadata related to the location of imaging files within the NDA and their S3 bucket"                                                                                                                                                                                                  ,
  '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/package_info.txt dname="package_info" label="package_info.txt" >}}'                                                    , "High-level information about the Data Package and Filter Cart at the time of Data Package creation. Note that the counts listed in this file may not relate to the files that were downloaded (e.g., this file refers to 1053 participants in the filter, but 585 participants were downloaded)." ,
  '{{< downloadthis assets/nda/README.pdf dname="README" label="README.pdf" >}}'                                                                      , "Information that pertains to some NDA Data Packages."
)
```
